resources.string: Set up card data and rules
Open Catalog to import English card data or approve an available download. Import an English rules TXT file in Rules to read and search it offline.
Decks, collection records and games are saved locally. Uninstalling the app or clearing its storage deletes this data. Android backup and full app-state restore are not available in this release.
Export saved decks and your collection before removing the app. Text exports do not preserve every setting, version or game history, and are not a complete app backup.
Downloads need explicit approval for the displayed source. Optional AI providers require separate setup and consent; provider-free prompt editing and copying can be used locally.
